predecessor_metadata.body:
The frozen K.P30m parent has a limited G5A baseline admission from PR1350, but its future validation lacked isolated clock/cashflow/checkpoint preparation. This adds a research-local supplied-input bridge reusing ObservedPaper and the unchanged parent, plus 26 focused synthetic integration/regression cases. Original/residual quantities, fixed initial-R, PIT cost decomposition, signed funding boundaries, passive BE/runner observations, metadata-first use-history classification, single-writer/hash-bound recovery and input-reference isolation are connected. No collector, market replay, FULL allocation, backend activation, order or strategy tuning is added.

The single proposed protocol separates future G5A purged30d OOS from post-shortlist G5B W1/W2/W3. The five-path future bundle (G5A1 plus G5B base/shift/two optional preregistered entry-cost stability diagnostics4) is unapproved; exact runtime identity construction, conditional release and hard ends are specified. Its new policy choices do not inherit the baseline approval. Actual execution remains BLOCKED: normal device connectivity/current unseen inventory and PIT/signed-funding/intrabar provenance are unverified; market-capable wiring, shift/adjacent/FDR/terminal paths remain unimplemented. Extra improvement preparation is NO_SUPPORTED_CHANGE.

Validation: focused26/26 PASS, independent code/protocol review PASS, source28/88 pointers and access24 source hashes PASS, canonical frontend pre/post PASS, Python compile/diff/document hash integrity PASS. Original119 audit and oldFULL are not repeated. Twelve additive files only; existing backend, guard/seal/allowlist/workflow, shared21identity/MICRO and SR/HG1997 states/budgets are unchanged. Existing normal saved/synthetic CI discovers the added test. No deployment is needed. The authenticated GitHub API stored an exact tree match to the locally reviewed commit.
